== Notes ==
* When looking for skills to meet Discord's conditions, consider those that either inflict their hexes or conditions in an area (e.g. [[Barbed Signet]], [[Blood Bond]]) or have low energy costs, cast times, and recharge times (e.g. [[Parasitic Bond]], [[Enfeeble]]).
** Similarly, [[Glyph of Immolation]] (followed by any hex that targets a foe) will set up Discord by applying the condition and hex together. (If the foe has already been hexed, just casting Discord is sufficient; the damage triggers because the Glyph's condition is applied ''before'' Discord checks the target's status.)
* This is the backbone skill for the PvE team build [[Discordway]].
